findings.title: No raw data or analysis code deposited — primary inferential statistics not independently reproducible
findings.evidence: Paper (p.159-175) deposits no data/OSF/Zenodo/GitHub link. ESM_MOESM1.pdf (sourced from media.springernature.com) contains only Appendix A (instructions), B (hurdle model + M-estimators), C (threshold derivations) — no per-subject data. All of Table 2 regressions, Table 3 Wilcoxon values, hurdle/M-estimator coefficients require raw data.
findings.cause: 2011-era publication predates open-data norms; 'complete test available on request' refers to the questionnaire.
findings.fix: Deposit anonymized per-pair data + z-Tree/.do analysis code (e.g., OSF/Zenodo) to allow third-party reproduction; at minimum publish the aggregate cell data.

findings.title: In-text Wilcoxon p-value does not correspond to its own reported W statistic
findings.evidence: Main text (p.172): 'W=1.120, p-value=0.904' for md>=mr & pd<=pr Accountability. Recomputing p = 2*(1-Phi(|W|)) for W=1.120 gives p=0.2628 (R 0.2627, Python 0.2627). The printed 0.904 matches the W=0.120 row (md<mr, qd>=qr, Accountability, p=0.9049) elsewhere on the same page.
findings.cause: Apparent copy-paste of the p-value from the adjacent W=0.120 row into the W=1.120 row.
findings.fix: Correct the p-value to ~0.263 (still non-significant, so no conclusion changes) or re-report the exact signed-rank p.

findings.title: Internal inconsistency in the count of zero givers: Table 1 / prose '90%' imply 7, footnote 19 & Appendix B say 8
findings.evidence: Table 1 'share offering nothing' 0.08/0.04/0.17 -> integer counts 2/1/4 = 7 of 72 (pooled 0.10, 7/72=0.097). Prose 'positive transfers 90% of the time' matches 7 zero-givers (65/72=0.9028), not 8 (64/72=0.8889). Footnote 19 and ESM Appendix B (p.1) both state 'EIGHT dictators choosing s=0' (8/72=0.111). Appendix B 'unselfish (>=5%)' DW=21, DB=22 implies 3 below-5% in DW and 2 in DB.
findings.cause: Rounding of per-treatment shares plus inconsistent zero-giver totals across tables/footnotes.
findings.fix: Reconcile: state the exact counts of s=0 (and of 0.01/0.02) givers per treatment; make Table 1 shares and the '90%' prose and footnote 19/Appendix B all agree.

findings.title: Pooled (s-xa) and (s-xl) means (-0.13, -0.11) differ from the unweighted average of the printed treatment means (-0.123, -0.117)
findings.evidence: Treatment means are internally consistent with derived xa/xl (DW -0.066/-0.138, DB -0.124/-0.024, BL -0.189/-0.189). Pooled recomputed from printed 2-dp cell means: (s-xa) -0.1233 (rounds -0.12), (s-xl) -0.1167 (rounds -0.12); paper prints -0.13 and -0.11.
findings.cause: Rounding drift: the pooled mean is computed from full-precision cell data, not from the 2-dp printed cell means.
findings.fix: Confirm pooled means computed from raw cell data; add a note on rounding. No inference change.

findings.title: Pooled justice F-tests report df2=60 for n=72, implying an undocumented ~12-parameter unrestricted model; pooled qnt-lib F p is just above the stated '<0.0020' bound
findings.evidence: Pooled F-tests use F(2,60): 72-60=12 estimated parameters, not a plain 2-parameter regression (which would be F(2,70)). The pooled regression specification (treatment dummies/interactions) is not documented in text. Also 'p-values<0.0020 in all the cases' for pooled natural principles is violated by the bootstrapped-quantile libertarian F=6.79(2,60) -> p=0.0022.
findings.cause: Unreported fuller model specification for pooled columns; rounding of F in the table.
findings.fix: Document the pooled regression specification (variables, df); state p precisely.

findings.title: fn14 KS D=0.33 (n=24,24) p=0.089 not matched by standard two-sample asymptotics
findings.evidence: For D=0.33, n1=n2=24, two-sided asymptotic p computed as ~0.1465 (basic) or ~0.0695 (Stephens finite-n correction). The exact two-sample p requires the empirical distributions (raw data) and could plausibly be 0.089, but is not independently computable here.
findings.cause: Secondary descriptive statistic; exact value depends on the ECDF arrangement (raw data).
findings.fix: Recompute with the exact two-sample KS p from raw offers; document the package used.
